largest-list.title: Largest list, 2019–2022: how these towns voted
largest-list.question: Share of valid votes cast in each locality, computed from the Central Elections Committee's per-locality result files for the 21st–25th Knessets.
largest-list.note: Files for each election at media21–media25.bechirot.gov.il/files/expc.csv. Lists are named as they ran that year: Blue and White (Gantz–Lapid) ran jointly in 2019–20; in 2021 Yesh Atid and Blue and White ran separately. Kibbutz Movement kibbutzim are those the CBS 2022 localities file assigns to the Kibbutz Movement (237–238 matched in each election file). Soldiers' and other double-envelope votes are not assigned to any locality. Places, not people: every city includes traditional, religious and Arab voters

vote-2022.title: November 2022, selected lists: how these towns voted
vote-2022.question: Share of valid votes cast in each locality, 25th Knesset election, computed from the Central Elections Committee's per-locality result file.
vote-2022.note: National Unity was the 2022 joint list of Blue and White and New Hope. Meretz fell below the electoral threshold nationally
